storyInfo: Reunion and Milana officially start working together as the Ursine army raids Reunion's farm. Fyodor digs up an empty coffin as Klim buries his wife, and Kal'tsit abandons eternal life as she returns AMa-10's core code to the Sarcophagus to stabilize and seal it for good.

attributes.content: Thank you for the generous invitation, Talulah.
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: I understand it's hard for your farm to take in so many residents and miners at once.
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: Taking in some non-Infected is also a dilemma for your people.
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: But please trust me when I say we are all skilled workers. We need only shelter to be self-sufficient, and we'll take care of anyone who needs our help.
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: I'm not worried about your people at all. I saw what they can do in Zelgrad, Tulin—I mean, Milana.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: Sorry, it'll take some time for me to get used to it.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: No, I should be the one apologizing. I took up that name myself, causing such a long misunderstanding.
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: So, the reason you've brought me over here for a chat is...?
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: To discuss what to do next... discuss our future.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: I once fought the imperial army in the countryside by scattering their forces, and I was sure this was the best way to deal with them.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: But we were naive and disorganized then. Some of us lost our convictions, and some went astray... most of them are dead now.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: We enjoyed a relatively peaceful period after... I spent my days wondering if we could shore up our numbers, tighten our bonds, and hold onto our original ideals—
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: If we can let all Infected... no, all our comrades believe in a better future, have everyone share the same dream, perhaps things could be different this time?
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: We've found the enemy we must defeat, and now, we need to gather more comrades to our cause.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: I'm glad to hear that, but I can't help but feel a little regret.
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: I'm sad Tulin never got to meet you.
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: I would be ashamed to meet him, Milana...
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: I heard plenty of your stories from Lyudmila... we walked similar paths, experienced similar suffering, but you've done much better than I.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: You've never fallen to despair.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: I'm sorry, but I don't quite get you...
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: Isn't Reunion a group of strong warriors who have fought their way here? Why would you say something like that...?
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: I'll tell you what happened, if I get the chance.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: Anyway, Milana. If you are willing to continue down this path of resistance to the injustices of the empire... let us journey, side-by-side.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: I would be honored.
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: The youth steps forward and grabs Talulah's hand.
Though, I only know your name, your team—
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: They have no name... we never had the time to work one up.
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: But I hope we can work under Reunion's name, if you'd let us.
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: What...?
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: Don't get me wrong, it's not that I want to permanently borrow someone else's name.
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: No, I'm just worried... Reunion has a past full of mistakes. Perhaps our name might cause some more misunderstandings.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: Do you still remember, Talulah? When I told you how the most depressed miners would surge back to life upon hearing your stories.
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: Even in Zelgrad, an affluent city in the south, there are still people who act in your name to bolster their voices.
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: If we want a name inspiring enough to unite those in pain and frighten those oppressors, our only option in this country is Reunion.
attributes.name: Milana

attributes.content: Perhaps...
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: Talulah, I finally found you—
attributes.name: Reunion Member

attributes.content: Hold on, we aren't done talking just yet.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: Forgive me, but it's urgent news from the south—
attributes.name: Reunion Member

attributes.content: Something's happened on our farm.
attributes.name: Reunion Member

attributes.content: Under the gloomy sky, a fierce fire rages.
First, the barn roof flies into the sky, but before the wooden frame touches the ground, another shell smashes through the barn, flipping barrels by the well...
Over the distant hillside, cannons flash and flicker, like matches being lit, one after another.
Enemy artillery! Everyone hide, and fast—
attributes.name: Reunion Member

attributes.content: Another barrage of shelling hits the field even before that shout could finish. Splintered wood and dirt rain down as burdenbeast herds neigh alongside children crying, their long period of peace ripped apart.
Wh-What's going on...?
attributes.name: Reunion Member

attributes.content: Don't panic, just think what you should be doing now!
Nine! You're here!
attributes.name: Reunion Member

attributes.content: I've brought reinforcements, and more hands for evacuation efforts.
attributes.name: Nine

attributes.content: Go and see if we've missed anyone who needs help moving. Get them all out, then evacuate at once.
attributes.name: Nine

attributes.content: We'll hold them off, no matter who they are!
attributes.name: Nine

attributes.content: Right!
attributes.name: Reunion Member

attributes.content: I'm terribly sorry, Mr. Bułka. Please keep your distance from us, and join the evacuation team for now.
attributes.name: Nine

attributes.content: This is for your safety.
attributes.name: Nine

attributes.content: Alright, Nine. For, ah—
attributes.name: Kazimierzian Merchant

attributes.content: We, we're willing to continue our discussion, and trade if you can—
attributes.name: Kazimierzian Merchant

attributes.content: Someone, take him away!
attributes.name: Nine

attributes.content: A-Alright, I'll go, I'll go now...
attributes.name: Kazimierzian Merchant

attributes.content: Nine and the Reunion warriors following her arrive in the center of the farm, looking upwards at the massive infantry force rushing down the hill.
Before her blossoms a sea of blood-red flowers, surging towards their enemies.
Sir! Two telegrams just came through.
attributes.name: Radioman

attributes.content: Go ahead.
attributes.name: Stern Officer

attributes.content: The first: a protest from Kazimierzians. There is fighting on the Ursus-Kazimierz Border, and there's already—
attributes.name: Radioman

attributes.content: Enough. No need to concern ourselves with the Kazimierzians, next.
attributes.name: Stern Officer

attributes.content: Sir... this is from headquarters. The Marshal is still recovering from her wounds, but is very satisfied with your progress, and hopes to see the Ursine banner flying over the traitors' base as soon as possible.
attributes.name: Radioman

attributes.content: Heh, we should have done this much sooner... Send a reply: we will fly the flag of the First Army alongside the flag of Ursus.
attributes.name: Stern Officer

attributes.content: I will show every citizen of our country the most glorious army on this land.
attributes.name: Stern Officer

attributes.content: The most glorious army, huh...?
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: I know Father and Mother were not buried together.
Father is interred in the royal mausoleum, while Mother is buried in the apple orchard of the summer palace, in a small graveyard at the end of the rows.
...I couldn't possibly have hidden this fact from my mind by simply refusing to think about it.
This... is not an apple orchard.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Your Imperial Majesty, this was on my mind as well.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: During the reign of the last Tsar, there was a rust sickness outbreak, so the original trees were removed and replaced with other varieties.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: This happened before you were born.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: So the grave on the side here...
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Who does it belong to?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: ...I did my investigation before you decided to come, and found no one in the palace records. The grave is much smaller than what one would expect for a royal tomb.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: According to tradition, what is buried below may be a beloved pet—
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: No. Even a pet would have a name. But this grave lacks one.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Only a single inscription is carved upon the stone.
'For my eternal love. Here I lay to rest in peace her soul.'
Inside the cemetery, a small, simple gravestone leans upon an ornate, royal tombstone, like a child nestling in its mother's arms.
Dig it up.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: ...I beg your pardon?
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: I said, dig out the coffin inside the grave!
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Majesty!
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Whatever it is you are trying to prove, this is only a fake. It can only be a fake.
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: What are you saying?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: An unidentified individual claiming to be a Grand Princess has appeared in Bresk, with the Grand Duchess's clear support.
attributes.name: Respectful Servant

attributes.content: This is proven by her first appearance in the city to appease the masses, but there is one thing our spies have so far failed to understand.
attributes.name: Respectful Servant

attributes.content: That this 'princess' has made no effort to conceal her face, and according to witnesses...
attributes.name: Respectful Servant

attributes.content: The usually frank servant suddenly pauses. She looks up at the Tsar to observe his expression, as if unsure if she should continue.
Out with it.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Her face is a picture-perfect replica of the late tsarina's.
attributes.name: Respectful Servant

attributes.content: In Bresk and the Far North, practically every household has a 'Red Corner', where they display portraits of the late tsar and tsarina.
attributes.name: Respectful Servant

attributes.content: You need only see and hear her, and witness her 'divine' gifts...
attributes.name: Respectful Servant

attributes.content: It was but a matter of time before word of this false Grand Princess reached the capital.
attributes.name: Respectful Servant

attributes.content: There are no princesses of Ursus, the late Tsar had no other children. You must know this truth better than anyone else, otherwise all our efforts will have been in vain—
attributes.name: Witte

attributes.content: Do not make me repeat myself, Witte.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Open it, even if it's just for my sake alone...
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: The coffin was buried in a shallow grave—one man is enough to haul it up.
It opens to a question. The small box, enough only to house a pet or young child, is completely empty.
No remains nor any belongings are inside.
Nothing at all.
The Tsar approaches the coffin and gets down on one knee, reaching out to rub the surface.
Finally, he spots a name engraved upon it.
...'Anastasia Vladimirovna Lacitsara'.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Anastasia.
Sister.
Nastya.
He looks up at the yellow-green leaves and branches, growing from the trees—none of them apple trees.
If the dead are not dead, if vivid memories can be wrong, if forgotten history can be recovered, then...
What other impossibilities lie in wait?
...This will do.
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: 'Two meters long, one-and-a-half meters wide, one-and-a-half meters deep.'
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: All the land that a person needs their entire life. So this is what it looks like.
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: I don't have a coffin, but this will fit one woman.
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: And only one.
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: How I wish... I could just stay here with you. To dig another hole next to yours, to lie down and close my eyes, to keep you company forever.
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: But I can't. I know where Lada is now, so I have to follow those people to find her.
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: Oh, yes. I never got to tell you...
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: I heard Lada's voice on our frequency.
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: She's grown, and she remembers everything... she remembers every story we told her. She recognized them immediately!
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: She's so smart... she takes after you.
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: I know, you want to go back to Chernobog, but I can only bring you here for now.
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: Wait until I see Lada again. I'll bring her here to see you.
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: And then, together...
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: We'll go home.
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: '...General Afanasy Igorevich Khratov, former commander of the Sixth Army's First Division and chief of staff.'
He first distinguished himself in the battle of the Four Emperors, and in the Tenth Ursus-Kazimierz War, led a small elite force to thwart the enemy's counterattack, a rare feat amongst his peers.'
'Later, he demonstrated exemplary prowess in both border and local conflicts with his considerable expertise in combat, raid, suppression, and mediation operations.'

'He learned from his defeat on the Bloodpeak Campaign, and in the Great Rebellion, led his troops away from the Sixth Army and surrendered to the State Council, all to buy more crucial time for a later counterattack...'
What are you up to, General?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Nothing, just reading.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: What's the book?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Just something a friend returned to me. Are you interested?
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: Not itching to read it... I remember you having a thread-bound book no one was allowed to touch, and this one is in even worse condition.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: They have similar content.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: You can have this one, if you like.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: In between his words, Hellagur swiftly lifts the book to show her the cover, while simultaneously ripping out the page he just read, crumpling it into a ball in his palm.
The already fragile book shakes only slightly, instead of falling apart.
...Let's just say I haven't given up yet, General.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: We have a moment's pause for now, but there are even bigger waves about to roll in.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: So I must ask again. You have seen so much more in recent days, yet you're still unwilling to return to our side?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: No.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: What if—what about returning to a brand new Ursus?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: That's not the main point, Eloysius.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: I refuse, because I know deep inside this place is no longer my home.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: Well. Could I please ask you to accept this book at least?
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: From my father's... the Vice Chairman's collection. He always wanted to 'return it to its rightful owner'.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Of course, this is also a thank-you gift, for your help.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: Thank you for bravely defending me, Gospodin Hellagur.
attributes.name: Eloysius

attributes.content: The Endless March...? A novel? Or is this a history book?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: You can decide that yourself.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: The pages are practically falling out. Can I really borrow it?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Of course.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: Alright... thanks.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Oh yeah, almost forgot what I came here for. The Zelgrad group's back, and wanted an office gathering before they leave Ursus. Will you come?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: When?
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: Tonight.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Alright. I will be there.
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: ...Who are you looking for?
attributes.name: Voice from Outside

attributes.content: Just go in and ask...
attributes.name: Voice from Outside

attributes.content: Excuse me...
attributes.name: Gentle Youth

attributes.content: Is Vetochki, the miner from the citizen's forum here?
attributes.name: Gentle Youth

attributes.content: I've seen you before. Who might you be?
attributes.name: Hellagur

attributes.content: Oh, I...
attributes.name: Gentle Youth

attributes.content: (Whispers) I'm also a miner, a survivor from the Far North.
attributes.name: Gentle Youth

attributes.content: ...It's snowing again.
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: Who knows how many more in the capital will freeze to death tonight.
attributes.name: Voice Behind the Door

attributes.content: You will not manage to save them all, no matter what you might have in mind.
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: I should have known how much pride you've always had in yourself. Likewise, I will always be proud of you, Elotta.
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: How excellent you are, that I forgot to teach you the most fundamental principle.
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: This land has its own rules, and no one can change them by willpower alone.
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: The late Tsar failed, and as for our reigning Tsar and Witte... only failure awaits them in turn.
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: Should I take it that you're happy to see them fail?
attributes.name: Voice Behind the Door

attributes.content: And only with their failure, can you protect your own interests. But whose interests are you actually protecting, with the order you endorse?
attributes.name: Voice Behind the Door

attributes.content: I see you've forgotten, but the very 'people with something to gain' you're scoffing at were the same ones protecting those Infected from the Far North, and you.
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: So you see it as a sort of charity, and not an innate right?
attributes.name: Voice Behind the Door

attributes.content: I see it as just a slogan that sounds correct, but has absolutely no substance.
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: No... I'm completely wrong, while you're absolutely right—someone who stays still will never make any mistakes.
attributes.name: Voice Behind the Door

attributes.content: Chairman Witte and the others will do wrong, because they're trying to do something, trying to change, to stop something.
attributes.name: Voice Behind the Door

attributes.content: Why see compromises and appeasements as wise decisions, when staying stagnant has never been a difficult choice?
attributes.name: Voice Behind the Door

attributes.content: Still you try to fight reality with naive arguments... it's a habitual mistake, but a mistake of mine too.
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: Tomorrow I will bring you out of the city, but until then, just stay here and calm down.
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: Reflect on your rash actions and the disastrous consequences they're bringing onto the monarch you serve, as well as your family.
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: Father.
attributes.name: Voice Behind the Door

attributes.content: Do you still think me the girl who trembles at the mere mention of 'confinement' or 'reflection'?
attributes.name: Voice Behind the Door

attributes.content: You know well I grew out of that long ago.
attributes.name: Voice Behind the Door

attributes.content: I came back to see you again, because I wanted to. And now...
attributes.name: Voice Behind the Door

attributes.content: Since you remain obstinate, there are some matters I'll have to take into my own hands.
attributes.name: Voice Behind the Door

attributes.content: —Elotta!
attributes.name: Vasily

attributes.content: The evening breeze lifts the tattered curtains, revealing fresh footprints and bloodstains on the window frame.
Outside the broken window, the twin moons hang high in the night sky, as they always have.
But in the next moment, change occurs. Surprising, silent change.
Streetlights gradually flicker to life on the cold streets.
Lanterns from residences follow after.
Warm lights brighten, one-by-one, gradually blanketing the entire city. Like a palette daubed with bright colors, or a restarted heart beating again.
Mama, there's light!
attributes.name: Excited Child

attributes.content: The new year lights on the tree are lit up too!
attributes.name: Excited Child

attributes.content: Silly... I hear even the electric heaters are running again.
attributes.name: Relieved Civilian

attributes.content: Don't run about now, we got our bread. Let's go home quickly.
attributes.name: Relieved Civilian

attributes.content: Now we won't be cold, even if it snows!
attributes.name: Excited Child

attributes.content: Now we won't be cold, even when the snow melts.
attributes.name: Relieved Civilian

attributes.content: Cheerful laughter accompanies the lights turning on, filling the cold night with warmth.
Only the grand Amber Palace is left in the silent, long darkness.
...Alita.
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: Have I done what you wanted to do?
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.options: Are you sure you want to do this?

attributes.content: Why not?
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: You may have temporarily stabilized the Sarcophagus, but you need some assistance to turn it into a stable energy source.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: AMa-10's core code can be permanently stored here as an administrator program.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: From another angle, the Sarcophagus is indeed a fitting tomb for the name of AMa-10.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.options: A new story always begins from here.

attributes.content: Doctor, I've had many links to this Sarcophagus in my long past. Many times I have hidden its existence from civilization.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: Until the last time, when I chose to trust someone... and you know the outcome was not ideal.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: I remember my words, the last time when we sealed this Sarcophagus together.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: If they are truly able to reactivate it, I am willing to believe that it will only be reactivated by someone who's kind in nature.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: The future is in the hands of those who seek to truly change this world.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: Now, we are indeed faced with the choice once more—to cooperate with all civilizations upon this land, or to go it alone.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: I will not deny our current choice is akin to a desperate gamble. I cannot judge it with reason, but we no longer have time.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: Instead of being stubbornly conservative... we choose to stand on the side of 'hope'.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.options: Sounds like you've let go of some burdens.

attributes.content: Based on the information I've gathered, it seems like you have made the same choice.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.options: But this also means...;You won't get a next 'life'.

attributes.content: Isn't that great?
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: Having but one life, enough to live as a human—is this not a gift from fate?
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: Distant gunfire ceases, smoke slowly dissipates. Once again the setting sun bathes the broken city in a red glow.
You hear all armies have agreed to a temporary ceasefire, which means the people will have time to evacuate, for now.
So, you embark on your way home.
So you're saying the Sarcophagus is a stable power source now? I guess Ursus's energy crisis will be somewhat alleviated.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: We've done our part for Grypherburg, so we can say our mission's complete, right?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Even if they manage to draw out the Sarcophagus's energy, I fear it'll only be enough for a few nomadic cities in central Ursus to last through this winter.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: They still have a tough problem to solve in the long run.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: We can only hope, that the sealed Sarcophagus here won't trigger any more unnecessary conflict...
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: But Dr. Kal'tsit is back, and all of us are still here too. This mission has been a great success.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: You're right! We got Kal'tsit back! A total Rhodes Island victory!
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.options: We did what we could.;And from the results, we did pretty well.

attributes.content: You look to Kal'tsit, walking behind you.
I think... I've remembered many things, from a long, long time ago.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: About the Sarcophagus, as well as people and business related to it... only now can I consider those matters to have reached an outcome.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: Some memories are so distant they seem to be fading from my mind, which is a new feeling for me.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: Breathing like this... is suddenly a strange, novel feeling.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: Kal'tsit! If you don't feel well, I can hold you, just like before—
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: No... Thank you, I'm fine.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: I will get used to it... as I am now.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: ...as I will live this life of mine.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: Doctor, I need you to explain why you asked me to come here as soon as possible.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.options: Closure spent a long time preparing for this reunion.;Hopefully, you'll be pleasantly surprised.

attributes.content: It is indeed more magnificent than I imagined.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: ...You did it, all of you.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.options: Just like you said, Rhodes Island will not stop because of the loss of any one person.
Although we hope from the bottom of our hearts that no one will be lost in the first place.

attributes.content: The device here... a regional Originium stasis machine?
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: Is this the result of new Rhodes Island's research?
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.options: We put in a lot of work.;To make sure that accident won't happen again.

attributes.content: An admirable result... but I fear this will not be enough to fend her off completely.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.options: We still don't know her true aim...

attributes.content: Doctor, I just thought of something else.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: In Zelgrad, you found AMa-10's core code in the Sarcophagus's control program.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: AMa-10 was originally designed with access privileges to manage all kinds of devices from the previous civilization, but this function was ultimately not implemented.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: In other words... the code within the Sarcophagus was planted by her after waking up.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: If I were to make a reasonable guess, the next step of her plan involves more legacies left by the previous civilization.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: We may not know what exactly she's planning, but we have reason to believe she can do far more than what she has done, if she merely wanted to devastate the current civilization on this land.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: What you have experienced, is a proof that she is more observer than participant on this Terra.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.options: Actually, I heard her voice in a mine, in the Far North.

attributes.content: A debate that has lasted for millennia, a debate about civilization itself.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: Now, there is only one thing left to do...
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: Prove to her—that the civilization on Terra today has the potential to survive, that it has value.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.options: We choose to accept this invitation.

attributes.content: Hierda... where are we headed?
attributes.name: Borislav

attributes.content: Many of my companions are scared. No one's been well since the atrocities in Zelgrad, should we just leave Ursus...?
attributes.name: Borislav

attributes.content: We...
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: I don't think any suffering has to be inevitable. The pain imposed upon us is something that we should fight with all our strength.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: To help those who are suffering and defeat the ones inflicting the suffering... that's what we should do.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Someone once told me of her dream, of her vision for this land... when people will overcome their differences, and Terra becomes a home for everyone.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: There may be no end to suffering, but hope continues to live on.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: No, we won't be leaving yet, for now.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: There are still many of our people here suffering, awaiting salvation, and we can't abandon them.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Peter! Why did you—
attributes.name: Borislav

attributes.content: The spots! You caught it too?!
attributes.name: Borislav

attributes.content: Yeah... *cough* *cough* Couldn't dodge it in the end.
attributes.name: Despairing Infected

attributes.content: It's fine... leave me... I'm gonna die anyway—
attributes.name: Despairing Infected

attributes.content: Don't worry... we never leave any of ours behind.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Hierda reaches out, manifesting a pure Originium cluster from thin air in her palm.
Then, she inserts it into the Infected's heart.
Ughh—!
attributes.name: Despairing Infected

attributes.content: Hierda! What are you—
attributes.name: Borislav

attributes.content: Blood gushes from the wound, but only for a brief moment.
Soon, crystals spread all over. They cover his wound, then his entire body, and new flesh grows from the Originium.
A brand new body.
I... The pain, seems to be gone.
attributes.name: No Longer Despairing Infected

attributes.content: Am I... reborn?
attributes.name: No Longer Despairing Infected

attributes.content: It's a miracle! Hierda has shown us another miracle!
The crowd cheers, then bows and kneels before her.
The girl also gets to her knees. She clasps her hands and prays toward the distant sky.
God... please, tell me...
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Is suffering truly the only law of this world?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Poor child... How do I even break it to you?
attributes.name: Priestess

attributes.content: Pain in the mind always stems from a flawed perception of reality.
attributes.name: Priestess

attributes.content: But this is an eternal chasm between individual life and this universe, and also an unavoidable divergent path for civilization, that no one can escape.
attributes.name: Priestess

attributes.content: Though, not for long.
attributes.name: Priestess

attributes.content: I will find the answer for you all.
attributes.name: Priestess

attributes.content: Immersed in the bright light of the twin moons, she casts her gaze to the depths of the ocean.
